package rulefixtures

import "strings"

// scenario for builder_write_string_single_byte_literal: `strings.Builder.WriteString("x")` for single-byte literals instead of `WriteByte`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func scenario445Positive(items []string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for i, item := range items {
		if i > 0 {
			b.WriteString(",")
		}
		b.WriteString(item)
	}
	return b.String()
}
